pages.title: Nexus Tower
pages.description: Nexus Towers are  located on  converging points of  Source Leylines  allowing them to  harness the natural  source in the world  to allow easier  transportation  around the realm.

pages.title: Warp Nexus
pages.description: These towers use this natural source via their Warp Nexus, an ancient waystone containing a Nexus Scroll bound to the towers location.
